title: TOC Semio Window Tables
summary:
Register tables (TOC, list-of-X, glossary, references) now break across pages using longtable instead of a non-breakable Table/tcolorbox + tabular.

Register list windows render the title chrome once before the table; continuation pages repeat the window title row and column headers via longtable \endhead.

Key fixes: global long-mode flag, correct \endfirsthead placement, plain p-column spec for long mode, skip inter-row \noalign hrule separators that blocked page breaks.

Verified zwischenbericht TOC spans pages 2–3 with full ~106 entries including Ergebnisverwertung and Verzeichnisse; continuation page repeats Inhaltsverzeichnis title.
